profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Web Developer | PHP & Laravel | Backend Development | APIs | MySQL | Production & Server Troubleshooting
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Full-Stack Web Developer with 10+ years of experience building, maintaining, and deploying web applications and CMS-driven websites.

My core experience is in PHP, Laravel, MySQL, JavaScript, WordPress, and Kirby CMS, with a strong focus on backend development, APIs, performance, troubleshooting, and production deployments.

Throughout my career, I've worked across the full development lifecycle — from understanding business requirements and architecting solutions to development, testing, deployment, and ongoing production support. I enjoy solving problems that cross the boundary between application code and infrastructure, especially when a problem requires looking beyond the code itself.

In my current role at IV Interactive, I work on custom CMS solutions and web applications, build new features, troubleshoot issues ranging from the codebase to the server level, and collaborate with developers, QA, management, and other teams to turn business requirements into practical technical solutions.

Some areas I work with include:
• PHP / Laravel
• MySQL / SQL
• JavaScript / HTML / CSS
• REST APIs and backend integrations
• WordPress / Kirby CMS
• Linux / LAMP / NGINX
• Web performance and SEO optimization
• Testing, debugging, and production troubleshooting
• Deployment and server-side problem solving

I'm continuously learning and looking for opportunities where I can contribute as a hands-on senior developer, take ownership of technical problems, improve application reliability and performance, and help build maintainable solutions.

I'm particularly interested in Senior Full-Stack, Senior PHP/Laravel, and Backend-focused web development roles.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Design and develop customized CMS and web application solutions using Kirby CMS, WordPress, PHP, JavaScript, and related technologies, with a responsive mobile-first approach.
• Own features across the development lifecycle — from requirements and technical planning through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing production support.
• Build and maintain frontend and backend functionality for CMS-driven websites and web applications.
• Troubleshoot issues across the application and infrastructure layers, including codebase, database, configuration, and server-level problems.
• Collaborate with developers and QA throughout development and testing to identify issues early and maintain production quality.
• Work directly with management and cross-functional teams to clarify business requirements, evaluate technical approaches, define scope, and translate business needs into practical solutions.
• Contribute to website performance, SEO, reliability, and ongoing technical improvements across multiple client projects.
• Support production deployments, migrations, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting for live websites and applications.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Owned the technical development lifecycle for the company's web platform, from feature development through production deployment.
• Redesigned and rebuilt major areas of the website, including core tournament and bracket functionality.
• Designed and implemented new features based on requirements gathered directly from executive and marketing teams.
• Translated business and product concepts into working web applications and production-ready features.
• Helped launch and support the platform serving more than 3,000 active users.
• Worked across a LAMP stack with WordPress, JavaScript, jQuery, React, and Node.js.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained features for e-commerce websites and internal business tools using PHP, AngularJS, and React.
• Designed and implemented internal APIs using the Slim Framework.
• Partnered with the Marketing team to implement Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics integrations.
• Improved website performance through image optimization and JavaScript/CSS optimization, reducing page load times by up to 30%.
• Troubleshot and maintained production web applications across frontend, backend, and integration layers.

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed Joomla websites and components with technical specifications.
- Developed and implemented websites utilizing HTML and Joomla technologies.
- Managed time-sensitive updates, including content changes and database upgrades.	
- Developed and implemented website's functions add, edit, and update by using jQuery Ajax and JSON data response.
- Embedded jQuery libraries into the website like jQuery accordion, jQuery Calendar, jQuery validation.
- Configured and administered security settings and components of Joomla.
- Sample of typical projects/clients: USA Touch-up Auto Body Estimate System.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained and developed modules/themes for Wordpress.
 - Integrated the CMS to the internal systems via API.
- Decreased page load times by over 200% using a content delivery network.
- Worked with a large varied team including Java Developers, Marketing, QA team, and management.
- Integrated Memcache, Apache Solr, AWS.
